text:
Which statement about the elements in Group VII of the Periodic Table is correct?
A
Chlorine can displace bromine from bromides.
B
Group VII elements are all solids at room temperature.
C
Group VII elements occur as monoatomic covalent molecules.
D
Reactivity increases down Group VII.

options.label: A
options.text: Chlorine can displace bromine from bromides.

options.label: B
options.text: Group VII elements are all solids at room temperature.

options.label: C
options.text: Group VII elements occur as monoatomic covalent molecules.
